$comment: Screenshots allowed to stay taller than MAX_HEIGHT in e2e/screenshotSize.ts, which is the design 12.3 size gate. Same bargain as security/audit-exceptions.json: every entry names a reason, an owner and an expiry, the gate fails once an expiry passes, and it fails again once a listed shot comes in comfortably under the limit -- so an entry cannot outlive the fix it was waiting for, and nothing lives here by being forgotten. A shot that is simply too tall belongs in the spec that takes it, not here.
$comment2: T81 (#148) emptied the list of shots that were waiting for a fix. What is left is the one entry that is not waiting for anything: a page worth a whole-page shot, at a height a reviewer can still open. It keeps an expiry all the same, because the judgement is worth making again rather than inheriting -- and if a second page ever earns its way in here, raise MAX_HEIGHT instead of growing the list.

exceptions.reason: Not a shot waiting to be fixed: the patient summary really is worth a whole-page phone shot, which is what e2e/mobile.spec.ts asks for with WHOLE_PAGE. Design 6.5 is about the whole of a patient screen at 375px, and this is the longest of them. Its height is the page's own design and not the practice's data -- the hero, the range card, the stat tiles, two charts, the spike table (which lib/types.ts caps at three to five), at most three patterns and at most three questions -- so it comes in at about 6,200 pixels on every run and cannot grow with the stack. That is about three and a half phone screens: longer than MAX_HEIGHT allows, far short of the 80,000-pixel file that made the gate necessary, and legible end to end at any size a reviewer can open. T81 (#148) re-judged it after T57 (#87) landed the per-project default and left it as the one standing exception.
